caseName: Riley, Interim District Director, Bureau of Immigration and Customs Enforcement v. Radoncic
caseNameFull: Riley, Interim District Director, Bureau of Immigration and Customs Enforcement v. Radoncic

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. Motion of Washington Legal Foundation et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Demore v. Kim, ante, p. 510.
